      • setId

        public void setId(int id)
        Only set this if you're 110% sure what you're doing. Changing the ID will not always have an effect. If you want to copy a kit and create a new one, change this kit to your likings, then add it as new to the BackboneKits. A new ID will be auto-assigned then.
